currentPass.title: contained built-in STL preflight with cancellation, audit, and output proof

proven: Read-only local API exposes health, durable status, workspace, intake, route, output, tool, gate, and execution-request preview records.
Durable status files are committed product source and parse as JSON.
Browser dashboard renders current pass and source-truth paths from the API.
Default local settings define an app-owned runtime data directory without importing user files.
Metadata-only intake records omit source paths and contents and do not copy, move, delete, extract, execute, or launch source files.
Runtime data resolves through OS user-data conventions or an explicit absolute override and never depends on the source checkout path.
API and dashboard records expose logical location metadata instead of resolved personal filesystem paths.
Every tracked source file has a machine-readable purpose and maintenance record.
Every Python component, every top-level frontend function, and frontend/workflow file headers are protected by an explainability verifier.

A durable start guide, implementation guide, learning-resource map, pass-report template, architecture guide, file map, and code-explanation standard let a new human or model resume from repository truth.
Validated intake metadata maps deterministically to read-only route previews with planned steps and explicit blockers.
Route previews do not use source paths, read contents, open files, extract archives, execute routes, launch tools, or create outputs.
The dashboard renders route-preview status and candidates without treating preview state as execution readiness.
Route previews map to planned output bundles, expected artifacts, logical destinations, and required proof checklists.
Every output artifact remains planned and nonexistent, every proof item remains not proven, and create/open actions remain blocked.
Output planning exposes only logical app-owned locations and never creates directories, writes files, captures proof, or opens outputs.
Known maker tools are checked through PATH and narrowly scoped standard locations without executing processes or reading the registry.
Tool detection results expose tool identity, family, method, and executable name while withholding resolved installation paths.
Missing matches remain not proven, versions remain not proven, and launch/install/update/uninstall/repair actions remain blocked.
Route previews, output plans, and detected tool families compose into semantic tool dry-run plans.
Dry-run plans use logical source and destination references, select only family-compatible detected tools, and expose no resolved paths.
Dry-run planning constructs no command string, performs no file handoff, launches no process, writes nothing, and remains execution-blocked.
Execution gate policy allowlists only mesh-to-toolpath, reserves one future concurrency slot, and keeps execution disabled.
Gate evaluation distinguishes proven planning evidence from unproven authorization, containment, compatibility, cancellation, logging, and proof requirements.
No execution request is created, no authorization is accepted, no path or command is resolved, and no process or execution-side record is produced.
Read-only request previews compose deterministic logical intent from coherent dry-run plans and gate evaluations for mesh-to-toolpath only.
Request previews require explicit authorization but keep acceptance false, actor and timestamp absent, and request persistence disabled.
The complete append-only audit lifecycle is declared while its event list remains empty and audit writes remain disabled.
The dashboard renders request, authorization, audit, and execution-blocked truth without any action control.
An explicit local script can prepare one deterministic app-owned job workspace from a valid mesh-to-toolpath request preview.
Prepared jobs store only logical intent, create empty control, working, logs, and output directories, and accept no authorization.
A second explicit local script records cancellation intent idempotently without signaling or claiming that a process stopped.
Read-only job policy and catalog APIs expose path-redacted prepared and cancellation state while every HTTP mutation remains blocked.
Malformed, weakened, traversing, or symlinked job records fail closed and are never exposed as usable jobs.
The earlier working Makers Anvil prototype has a tracked design study that preserves accepted layout, workflow, wording, visual, and responsive lessons without becoming a runtime dependency.
Every comment-capable source file begins with visible structured context covering purpose, caller, inputs, outputs, side effects, safety, failure behavior, and related proof.
A file-by-file source walkthrough connects backend, frontend, scripts, structured contracts, tests, and durable truth for future humans and models.
The explainability checker rejects missing structured source context and undersized component documentation.
The first screen is a bounded preview-first maker workbench instead of a long equal-weight status stack.
Persistent rail navigation, quick-jump search, and stable Work Flow, Plans, and Dev tabs change browser views without mutating application state.
Source intake truth, selected-input metadata, tool inventory, work plans, job workspaces, expected output, and latest proof have dedicated synchronized work zones.
Desktop workbench layout fits 1366x768 and 1280x720 without page overflow; narrow screens reflow without horizontal overflow.
Browser upload and every operational command remain visibly blocked while read-only planning evidence stays available.
Every Python class, constructor, function, method, helper, and test carries all nine required teaching fields.
Every top-level JavaScript function and every CSS or semantic HTML block carries locally visible teaching documentation.
A generated line-numbered guide explains every physical implementation and structured-contract line, including comment-free JSON.
Exact source hashes and line totals make stale or incomplete learning coverage fail verification.
The previous working app is inventoried as migration evidence with explicit adopt, migrate, rebuild, and reject decisions instead of becoming a second runtime.
A local generated guide explains all 14,611 physical lines across 29 selected first-party previous-app files while excluding dependencies and generated data.
Native desktop mode owns one ephemeral loopback server and one secured pywebview window over the same current frontend and API.
Closing the native window deterministically shuts down its owned server; remote binds, downloads, file URLs, direct JavaScript bridging, devtools, and remote debugging remain disabled.
A deterministic Windows PyInstaller plan bundles the frontend and Python core into MakersAnvil.exe without a source-checkout path dependency.
The packaged executable has a headless smoke mode that proves bundled resources, API health, the bounded intake scope, and blocked route/tool truth.
A same-origin browser session receives an opaque process-local request token without exposing a selected source path.
One explicit authorization binds a reviewed file name, final allowlisted suffix, classified kind, byte length, and modification time for ten minutes.
The authorized transfer streams exactly one file into private app-owned quarantine storage in bounded chunks and records its SHA-256 digest.
Incomplete transfers roll back partial content and records; successful authorizations are one-time and cannot be replayed.
App-generated physical and logical names prevent a user-supplied file name from controlling the quarantine destination.
The source file is read by the browser only after explicit consent and is never moved, deleted, renamed, or exposed by path.
The API rejects cross-origin evidence, invalid tokens, archives, unsupported suffixes, folders, zero-byte files, oversized files, stale metadata, and wrong media types.
Only guarded intake and complete workbench-preference endpoints accept POST; every other state-changing API route remains blocked.
File intake does not hand content to a route or tool, extract archives, import folders, create outputs, or claim content-type or malware verification.
Five capability lanes derive supported inputs, current previews, planned routes, detected tool families, and output plans from existing schema-backed truth while execution stays false.
Contextual help uses one keyboard-accessible viewport-contained popover with reviewed purpose and safety boundaries for each major workbench surface.
Compact or comfortable density, full or reduced motion, and contextual-help visibility persist atomically in portable app-owned user data through the shared local request guard.
Completed intake and preference actions create immutable server-authored redacted activity files; browsers cannot submit arbitrary event text, paths, updates, or deletions.

The previous app's capability, help, event-history, settings, and restrained motion ideas are migrated into focused modules without importing legacy dependencies, paths, source storage, or process behavior.
One explicitly authorized app-owned STL can run a built-in streaming structural preflight with a single in-process concurrency slot.
The preflight verifies exact byte size, SHA-256 digest, and binary or ASCII STL structure without constructing a command or starting a process or external tool.
Cooperative cancellation is persisted and observed between bounded source reads without claiming an operating-system process signal.

Successful or failed preflight completion writes a path-redacted report, execution log, hashed proof, terminal manifest, and append-only fixed-vocabulary audit events under portable app-owned storage.
The guarded API and workbench expose explicit authorize, run, and cancel controls only for the built-in STL preflight while full mesh-to-toolpath execution remains false.
